تقتبسون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَبِسُونَ (taqtabisūna) /taq.ta.bi.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# تُقْتَبَسُونَ (tuqtabasūna) /tuq.ta.ba.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
